Initial release: Instantly turn free-form text into AI-generated videos with minimal setup.

- Converts written text, including TXT, DOCX, PDF (up to 500MB), into 1080p video clips with visuals and background music.
- No editing skills required—just describe your needs and receive a ready-to-download MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup with session and token management for quick access; free trial available (100 credits).
- Handles uploads, exports, credit checks, and timeline state via simple chat commands or file uploads.
- Supports common workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Full cloud rendering pipeline with support for multiple video and audio formats.
